name: Kingdom of Afghanistan
native: دولت علیه افغانستان (Dawlat-i ʿAlīyya-yi Afghānistān, 'Sublime State of Afghanistan')
alt: Afghanistan under Amanullah, Nadir Shah and Zahir Shah

predecessors.name: Emirate of Afghanistan
predecessors.text: the Emirate's whole territory: 'Succeeds Afghan emirate: 9 June 1926'

successors.name: Republic of Afghanistan (Daoud Republic)
successors.text: the whole country: 'In July 1973, Daoud Khan staged a bloodless coup d'etat while Zahir Shah was abroad'

ledger.x: 9 June 1926: Amanullah Khan proclaims the Kingdom of Afghanistan in place of the emirate.
17 January 1929: Kabul falls to Habibullah Kalakani.
Late May or early June 1929: Kandahar falls.
17 July 1973: Daoud Khan overthrows the monarchy.

wars.name: Afghan Civil War (1928-1929)
wars.outcome: Shinwari revolt at Jalalabad 14 November 1928; Kalakani attacked Kabul on 14 December and took it on 17 January 1929; Amanullah's Kandahar army failed (retreat from Ghazni 26 April, Kandahar lost 31 May/3 June); Nadir Khan crossed from the Kurram valley on 8…

certainty.note: The Durand Line was demarcated 1894-1896 and accepted in the treaties of 1919, 1921 and 1930 (Durand Line page); Afghanistan has not recognised it since 1947, but it did not move.
